Composition API Helpers: useAttrs().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { useAttrs } from 'vue'`).
Used in `<script setup>` / `setup()`. Returns the equivalent of `this.$attrs`.

Composition API Helpers: useSlots().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { useSlots } from 'vue'`).
Used in `<script setup>` / `setup()`. Returns the equivalent of `this.$scopedSlots`.

Composition API Helpers: useListeners().description:
Vue 2.7+ only (`import { useListeners } from 'vue'`).
Used in `<script setup>` / `setup()`. Returns the equivalent of `this.$listeners`.
No Vue 3 counterpart — Vue 3 merges listeners into `$attrs`.

Composition API Helpers: useCssModule().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { useCssModule } from 'vue'`).
Used in `<script setup>` / `setup()`. Accesses the classes injected by a `<style module>` block; the argument is the module name and defaults to `'$style'`.

Composition API Helpers: useCssVars().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { useCssVars } from 'vue'`).
Compiler-generated helper backing `v-bind()` inside `<style>`. Rarely written by hand.

Composition API Helpers: mergeDefaults().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { mergeDefaults } from 'vue'`).
Applies default values onto an existing props definition — the runtime helper `withDefaults()` compiles down to.

Composition API Helpers: useModel().description:
**Vue 3.4+ only — not available in Vue 2.7 or @vue/composition-api.**
In Vue 2, declare the prop and emit `update:<name>` by hand, or use the `model` component option.
Used in `setup(props) { }`. If using `<script setup>`, `defineModel()` should be preferred instead.

Composition API Helpers: useTemplateRef(.description:
**Vue 3.5+ only — not available in Vue 2.7 or @vue/composition-api.**
In Vue 2, read template refs off `this.$refs` / `getCurrentInstance().proxy.$refs`.

Composition API Helpers: useId().description: **Vue 3.5+ only — not available in Vue 2.7 or @vue/composition-api.**
